description: Returns a composited send-or-wait recommendation for a Bitcoin transaction. Fetches live mempool and fee data, then outputs a machine-actionable verdict (SEND_NOW, WAIT, or URGENT_ONLY) with fee rates in sat/vB, mempool pressure level, and estimated savings if you wait. Ideal for agents that need a single decision call instead of parsing multiple raw mempool endpoints.

urgency.description: How time-sensitive is your transaction? low=economy, medium=default, high=next-block.

name: btc_send_decision
